correctness.rationale: For any union of complete clique-coordinate orbits, independent sets have at most one chosen point per fiber. Their chosen layer labels give exactly proper partial r-colorings on the corresponding base set. This proves alpha(G[S times [r]])=b_r(S) in both directions. Constant barycentric coordinates on group orbits then give the exact PL simplicial model, with natural filtration maps. The colorable-base case has b_r(S)=|S|, a full simplex skeleton with an explicit acyclic toggle matching and integral sphere-wedge count. At k=m all proper faces are present and inclusion of the sole top simplex is equivalent to non-r-colorability. Edge cases m=2,k=2,k=m,k>m are included. A standalone exhaustive independent-formulation checker tested 162 graph/fiber cases, 416 direct invariant-face cases and Euler identities; the proof is unbounded and is not an extrapolation.

value.rationale: This is a natural and complete geometric fixed-point filtration of a recently studied topological graph invariant for all finite base graphs and every robustness parameter, not a selected numerical example. It gives graph-independent integral homotopy and full persistence for all r-colorable bases and an exact sphere/contractible transition that detects r-colorability for arbitrary H. This shows the geometric symmetry invariant captures more information than known ordinary homotopy or equivariant Euler summaries, and provides a reusable structural graph-product bridge to chromatic invariants.
